ana: Heads up — I'm opening a lockfile + vendor submodule bump PR against release/v1.12. Need someone to own the submodule propagation sanity check before cutoff (Fri 09:00 PT).

ana: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4567 — updates infra/vendor to abc123 and regenerates vendor.lock.

sasha: I'll take ownership for propagation and local smoke. Will run CI and sanity.

mike: Quick note — vendor subtree includes some generated native artifacts, please make sure we don't accidentally vend large .so files. I can grep and nuke any stray objects.

ana: Good catch. sasha — when you test, run the vendorize script below and check `du -sh vendor/*` for surprises:

```
git checkout release/v1.12
git submodule update --init --recursive
scripts/vendorize.sh
git add vendor/ vendor.lock
git commit -m "vendor: bump libfoo -> 2.3.1"
```

malik: Tagging myself as release manager for canary. Canaries scheduled Tue 02:00 UTC. If perf regressions show up I'll trigger a revert and page oncall. :thumbsup:
